description: Sends an incoming clock to one of eight gate outputs, picked at random every time the clock rises

params.text: The lowest-numbered output that can be picked, 1 to 8
The highest-numbered output that can be picked, 1 to 8; when it falls below MIN the range collapses onto that one output
Steps through three output shapes: TRIGGERS gives a 1ms pulse on the picked output, HOLD keeps it high until the next clock, GATE keeps it high while the clock stays above 1V

inputs.text: A rise above 1V picks a new output
Adds to MIN, one output per volt
Adds to MAX, one output per volt

outputs.text: 10V while that numbered output is the one picked
